title: Filipino-Style Braised Pork Belly with Dinuguan Sauce
description: A rich and savory dish that brings together the flavors of Japan and the Philippines. This braised pork belly is slow-cooked in a sweet and spicy dinuguan sauce, resulting in a tender and flavorful meal.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork belly until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the pork from the pot and set it aside.
Add the dinuguan sauce to the pot and bring to a boil.
Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the pork belly to the pot and add the soy sauce, sugar, rice vinegar, and water.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the pork for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Slice the pork into thick slices and serve with the braising liquid.
Garnish with green onions and serve with steamed rice.
